gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new SIP recording for a specific call using the Twilio API. I will provide the Account SID and Call SID in the request URL, along with any necessary parameters in the body to configure the SIP recording.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response with the details of the created SIP recording, including its SID and status.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to update the settings of an existing SIP recording for a specific call. I will specify the Account SID, Call SID, and the SIP recording SID in the request URL, along with the updated parameters in the body.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response confirming the update, along with the updated details of the SIP recording.
